ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Public comments regarding this agenda must be submitted via email to traffic@encinitasca.gov. Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Chair. Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the Commission and made a part of the meeting record.?
